verdict.rationale: The evidence never shows Edge0 being installed through a standard package manager. There is no pip, brew, npm or similar install command, and no package listing. The pack shows only a repo-local virtualenv script for fetching models and an `edge0 serve` CLI invocation, which imply a source checkout rather than a package-manager install.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager
